Gordon Brothers has previously said Poundland faces multiple economic challenges from rising inflation, increasing staff costs, and "severe levels of shoplifting".

articles.description: The new recipes mean cereal packaging will now include a 'contains wheat gluten' warning.
articles.summary: Rice Krispies and Coco Pops, long-standing staples of the family breakfast table, will no longer be made of whole rice grains in the UK, after Kellogg's said it was changing its recipe.
key_points: Instead the tiny toasted puffs will be made using corn flour and rice flour, and will also now contain wheat gluten as an ingredient.
A Kellogg's spokesperson said the reformulation was due to "changing weather conditions" that have disrupted supplies of some grains and cereals.

The cereal giant said the new versions had been "carefully assessed for taste, appearance and texture", but fans complained online they no longer made the famous "pop" sound and said their children would…

articles.title: Canva announces major job cuts after 'our hardest year yet'
articles.description: CEO Melanie Perkins says more than 1,000 staff will either lose their jobs or be asked to change roles.
articles.summary: Canva co-founder Melanie Perkins says this year has been "our hardest" yet Canva, one of Australia's best known start-ups, has announced a shake up of the business that will affect 22% of its workers, including job cuts.
key_points: In what was "without doubt the hardest moment in our thirteen-year history" co-founder and CEO Melanie Perkins said 1,271 people would either lose their jobs, be asked to relocate or change roles.
The firm's value has reportedly dropped in the past year over concerns about the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on its business as well as the cost of incorporating the technology into its…
It had been "our hardest year yet, and as we shared earlier this year, our growth has slowed for the first time in a decade," Perkins wrote to staff.

articles.title: Graduates are managing AI - but are they learning much else?
articles.description: Graduates are spending more time managing AI, but are they missing out on other work experience?
articles.summary: Recent university graduate Lotte Underwood is a public relations executive with a twist - she spends more time using AI than actually doing PR.
key_points: Underwood, 25, joined London-based PR agency Fight or Flight in November last year, in the new role of "AI associate" after completing a degree and then a masters in marketing.
She's part of a recently established, dedicated AI team that has built around 30 AI agents.
Specific tasks include industry research, client reporting, media interview preparation, helping clients create clearer briefs, and image generation.

articles.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
articles.description: The food deal, ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month, is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far.
articles.summary: The UK and EU have agreed a draft deal on removing post-Brexit checks from food and agriculture exports, ahead of the UK-EU summit later this month.
key_points: The BBC understands the 200-page draft text for this so called "SPS" [sanitary and phytosanitary] agreement has been circulated to EU nations in Brussels for consideration at a meeting on Wednesday.
Similar texts for deals on emissions trading and a youth travel and work scheme have also been circulated alongside a 15-page draft joint statement for UK and EU top leaders.
The food deal is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far, removing checks and red tape that hit exporters after the UK exited the EU's single market.

articles.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
articles.description: An engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives, Binance says.
articles.summary: Hackers who stole a record $6.3bn (£4.7bn) from Binance used fake job interviews and a compromised internal AI tool, the firm has revealed.
key_points: Initial findings published by the company, which operates the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, said hackers gained access to its systems through "sophisticated, multi-stage campaign".
It said they used a range of techniques such as malicious software downloads to compromise the computers of Binance engineers and gain control over tools to drain its wallet of billions of dollars…
Binance called it a "serious and highly sophisticated security incident" and apologised, saying "this should not have happened".

articles.title: Asda hires ex-Morrisons boss in bid to grow firm
articles.description: David Potts takes charge of Asda, which is based in Leeds, with immediate effect.
articles.summary: Asda has appointed a former Morrisons boss as chief executive to help lead revival efforts at the supermarket chain.
key_points: Asda, which is based in Leeds, said David Potts would take on the role with immediate effect, while current boss Allan Leighton would become non-executive chairman, two years after returning to lead the…

Potts led Morrisons from its Bradford headquarters for eight years until 2023, overseeing a turnaround during which the supermarket chain was bought by US private equity firm Clayton, Dubilier & Rice.
Potts said Asda had "made good progress but significant opportunities remain" to reinvigorate sales, with a focus on keeping prices low for shoppers.

articles.title: Mining giant joins fight to stop killer toad march across Australia
articles.description: Rio Tinto is jointly funding a A$28m "toad containment zone" to protect the Pilbara region.
articles.summary: Rio Tinto is ploughing millions of dollars into stopping the poisonous cane toad reaching the Pilbara region of western Australia, where the mining giant has a vast iron ore operation.
key_points: The firm, alongside Curtin University in Perth and others, will spend A$28m (£14.5m) building a "toad containment zone" to prevent the pest travelling south.
While the cane toad is not a direct threat to Rio Tinto's business, it produces toxins lethal to native wildlife and poses a threat to Pilbara's ecosystem.
Rio Tinto has previously faced criticism for destroying two sacred Aboriginal rock shelters in Pilbara which sat above tonnes of iron ore.

key_points: Regulator the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) said it would welcome lenders making settlement offers as long as customers were not given a worse deal than under its proposed central scheme.
That scheme is facing a legal challenge, to be heard in February, with resulting compensation unlikely to be paid until late next year.
But Barclays has confirmed it will make early compensation offers from now, with others expected to follow suit.
